description: Search scholarly literature across journals, conferences, preprints and books: title, authors, year, venue, citation count, DOI link and abstract where available. Optional fromYear filter and up to 20 results per call. Use for research agents, literature reviews, fact-checking a claim against published work, and finding the DOI for a citation. Example: query=CRISPR off-target effects, limit=5, fromYear=2020. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.

fromYear.description: Only works published in or after this year

query.description: Search terms, a title or a research question (3-300 characters)
